headlines.title: 구윤철 " 외환시장 예의주시...과도한 쏠림엔 즉시 조치 "
headlines.summary: 미국 관세와 이란 전쟁 영향에 외환시장 변동성이 커진 가운데 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관은 지나친 쏠림에는 필요한 조치를 즉시 취할 것이라고 밝혔습니다. 구 부총리는 오늘 오전 정부서울청사에서 주재한 시장상황점검회의에서 대외 불확실성이 높은 상황에서 불안 심리가 확산하지 않도록 높은 경계감을 가지고 예의주시하고 있다며 이같이 언급했습니다.

headlines.title: 구윤철 " 과도한 쏠림 즉시 대응 "… 환율 변동성 확대 경계
headlines.summary: 중동 전쟁·외국인 순매도에 외환시장 변동성 확대 정부, 금융·외환시장 리스크 점검 강화 채권시장 변동성에도 관계기관 공조 대응 [서울=뉴시스] 고범준 기자 = 이재명 대통령이 2일 청와대에서 열린 제24회 국무회의 겸 제11차 비상경제점검회의에서 구윤철 경제부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관과 대화하고 있다. 2026.06.02. bjko@newsis.

headlines.title: 환율 13.6원 오른 1530원 개장 … 2009년 ‘글로벌 금융위기’ 이후 처음
headlines.summary: 5월 외환보유액 8.8억달러 감소 구윤철, 시장개입 가능성도 시사 환율 ‘고공행진’ 4일 오전 서울 중구 하나은행 본점 딜링룸 현황판 앞을 한 직원이 지나가고 있다. 이날 원·달러 환율은 전날 주간 거래 종가보다 13.6원 오른 1530.0원에 개장했는데, 환율이 1530원을 넘겨 거래를 시작한 것은 글로벌 금융위기였던 2009년 3월 10일(1554.

headlines.title: 원/달러 환율 , 3월 이후 첫 1530원 돌파…美 관세 · 중동 영향 겹쳤다
headlines.summary: (서울=뉴스1) 권현진 기자 = 4일 오전 서울 중구 하나은행 본점 딜링룸 전광판에 코스피와 원·달러 환욜이 표시되고 있다. 이날 환율은 미국과 이란의 군사적 충돌 재개에 강달러 기조가 강해지며 달러·원 환율이 1530원까지 치솟았다. 코스피는 전 거래일 대비 177.67포인트(2.02%) 내린 8,623.82로 출발했다. 2026.6.

headlines.title: 환율 두달 만에 다시 1530원대로
headlines.summary: 장중 1530.8원, 3월 31일 이후 최고치 외환보유액도 5월 8억8000만弗 감소 이란의 미군기지 공격에 유가 등 상승 구윤철 “과도 쏠림 즉시 조치 취할 것” 원/달러 환율이 약 두 달 만에 1530원을 다시 돌파했다. 시작가 기준으로는 글로벌 금융위기 이후 처음이다. 서울 중구 명동 일대 환전소 모습.

headlines.title: OECD 한국 성장 률 2.6% 전망, G20중 전망 상향폭 최대
headlines.summary: 세계경제 성장률 전망치, 3월(2.9%) 대비 하향된 2.8% 제시 한국경제 성장률은 같은 기간 1.7%→2.6%, G20국가 중 상향폭 최대 (부산=뉴스1) 윤일지 기자 = 지난 3월 우리나라 수출이 반도체 '슈퍼 사이클'(초호황)에 힘입어 사상 처음으로 800억 달러를 돌파하며 역대 최대 실적을 기록했다.

headlines.title: 닭고기 수급난 … 굽네치킨, 가격 인상 대신 중량 줄였다
headlines.summary: 닭다리살 순살·윙봉·통다리 중량 축소 ‘치킨 중량 표시제’ 시행 6개월만 첫사례 “판매가·공급가 인상 어렵자 고육지책” [굽네치킨 홈페이지] 고병원성 AI(조류인플루엔자) 여파로 닭고기 수급난을 겪는 프랜차이즈 치킨업계에서 중량 조정 사례가 나왔다. 정부가 슈링크플레이션 방지를 위해 ‘치킨 중량 표시제’를 시행한 지 약 6개월 만이다.

headlines.title: 중소기업 10곳 중 7곳 “원부자재값 20%이상↑”
headlines.summary: 중기중앙회, 410개 중기 대상 조사 36.1% “현재 재고로 1개월도 못 버텨” 현상황 지속시 40% 조업 축소할 것 중동 정세 불안 이후 원부자재를 쓰는 중소기업 10곳 중 7곳이 주요 원부자재 매입단가가 20% 이상 올랐다고 응답했다. 보유 재고가 1개월 미만이라는 기업도 36.

headlines.title: 수도권 레미콘 총파업 … 반도체 건설현장도 올스톱
headlines.summary: 수도권 믹서트럭 8일부터 운행중단 예고 평택·용인 반도체 공사현장 차질 우려 노조성 인정·건설사 직접 협상 변수도 수도권 레미콘 운송사업자들이 8일부터 전면 운행 중단을 예고하며 각종 공사 현장의 차질도 현실화되고 있다. 사진은 대기 중인 레미콘 믹서트럭들의 모습.  [연합] 수도권 레미콘 운송사업자들이 오는 8일부터 전면 운행 중단에 들어간다.

headlines.title: 루비오 “미국 기업 향한 한국의 일부 태도, 무역합의에 영향 줬다”

headlines.title: 일자리 진입 3년째 감소, 역대 최소 … 재작년 청년층 7만3천명 ↓

key_headlines.title: Korean Won Falls to 1530 per Dollar for First Time Since Global Financial Crisis
key_headlines.summary: The USD/KRW exchange rate surged past 1530 won on June 4th, marking the first time since the 2009 global financial crisis, driven by strong dollar demand amid US tariffs and Middle East tensions.

key_headlines.title: South Korea Eyes 1 Trillion Dollar Export Milestone with AI Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: Korea targets 900 billion dollars in exports this year following record 700 billion dollars in 2025, with semiconductor and power equipment exports surging in the AI era, positioning the country to potentially rank 5th globally.

key_headlines.title: Ready-Mix Concrete Drivers Strike to Halt Construction Including Semiconductor Plants
key_headlines.summary: Ready-mix concrete transport operators in the Seoul metropolitan area announced a full operational suspension from June 8th, threatening work stoppages at major construction sites including semiconductor factories in Pyeongtaek and Yongin.

key_headlines.title: Consumer Prices Rise Above 3% for First Time in 26 Months Due to Energy Shock
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's consumer price inflation climbed above 3% for the first time in 26 months as Middle East tensions pushed oil prices higher, with impacts visible across energy costs and food prices.

key_headlines.title: OECD Raises Korea's Nominal Growth Forecast to 10.4% Amid Memory Chip Price Surge
key_headlines.summary: The OECD significantly raised its nominal growth rate forecast for Korea to 10.4% and the GDP deflator to 7.6% due to soaring memory semiconductor prices and export performance.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy faces significant headwinds as the won weakened to 1530 per dollar for the first time since the 2009 financial crisis, driven by Middle East tensions and strong dollar sentiment. Foreign investors have sustained 19 consecutive days of net selling on the KOSPI, dumping over 5.6 trillion won recently. Consumer price inflation surged above 3% for the first time in 26 months as Middle East-driven oil prices spiked, with broader concerns about sustained inflationary pressure. Despite these challenges, Korea's export sector shows resilience with targets for 900 billion dollars in 2026 exports following a record 700 billion dollars in 2025, buoyed by semiconductor and power equipment demand in the AI era.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The OECD raised Korea's nominal growth forecast to 10.4% for 2026, significantly higher than previous estimates, citing surging memory semiconductor prices and strong export performance. Global inflation pressures are intensifying due to Middle East-related energy costs, with the US Federal Reserve's Beige Book reporting moderate to strong price increases across most regions. The Fed is signaling potential rate hikes starting in December 2026, with markets currently pricing in a 41.1% probability of increases by that time. South Korea's government is strengthening financial and foreign exchange market monitoring under Deputy Prime Minister Gu Yoon-cheol, with potential intervention signals to manage excessive exchange rate volatility. Consumer price inflation has broken above the 3% threshold, prompting heightened vigilance on inflation management.
sections.Financial Markets: The Korean won plummeted to 1530 per dollar on June 4th, the weakest level since the 2009 financial crisis, as foreign investors continued aggressive selling with 19 consecutive trading days of net outflows from the KOSPI. US Treasury yields have risen sharply, with the 10-year yield approaching 4.5% and 30-year yield testing 5.0% levels amid Middle East tensions and energy cost concerns. The KOSPI fell 2.02% to 8,623.82 points, while the KOSDAQ recovered after six consecutive days of declines, showing potential for rebound in the second half. Foreign institutional investors dumped over 3 trillion won on the Korean market during recent sessions, with overseas investor sentiment remaining negative despite supportive macroeconomic fundamentals. Bond market volatility has expanded significantly, prompting coordinated government and financial sector responses.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korean pharmaceutical and biotech companies achieved record first-half global technology export contracts of 13.07 trillion won, surpassing the previous year's 12.28 trillion won record and demonstrating robust competitiveness. The global electric vehicle battery market excluding China grew 21% in the first four months of 2026, though Korean battery makers' market share declined despite the overall market expansion. South Korea's effective tariff rate with the US fell to the 6th highest among the top 10 exporters in the first quarter, down from 3rd position in the second quarter of 2025, with tariff rates for automobiles declining while steel increased. Rising gasoline prices are driving electric vehicle demand domestically, with Kia accelerating its full EV lineup strategy including models EV3, EV5, and PV5. The automotive sector faces mixed tariff conditions, with the US set to reduce tariff rates on steel and aluminum derivatives to 15% starting June 8th for agreement nations including Korea.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul Mayor-elect Oh Se-hoon identified real estate as the city's most critical issue, highlighting the severity of declining jeonse deposits and surging monthly rent increases, calling for urgent policy direction changes to prevent a real estate crisis. Apartments subject to the price cap system in the Seoul metropolitan area attracted over 2.5 times higher subscription rates compared to non-capped units this year, as homebuyers seek more affordable pricing options. The Seoul metropolitan area housing supply shortage is gradually expanding to Gyeonggi Province and Incheon as prices continue rising, though the overall rate of increase has moderated. Mayor Oh's administration plans to accelerate private redevelopment and reconstruction projects, targeting 310,000 new housing unit starts by 2031 to stabilize prices through expanded private-led supply. The real estate sector is shifting focus to alternative housing types including officetels and multi-family homes as solutions to the apartment supply shortage.
sections.International Economy: The US Trade Representative announced 12.5% additional tariffs on 54 countries including South Korea, China, and Japan, citing insufficient efforts to prevent forced labor products, with 10% tariffs applied to six countries including the EU. The US reduced tariff rates on steel and aluminum derivatives to 15% starting June 8th for tariff agreement nations including Korea, with an estimated 2.3 billion dollars worth of Korean exports benefiting. South Korea's effective tariff rate on US trade fell from 3rd place in Q2 2025 to 6th place in Q1 2026, marking the steepest decline among the top 10 exporters to America. US equity markets declined across all three major indices amid Middle East tensions and surging oil prices, with commodity-sensitive sectors under pressure. Currency markets show the won weakening significantly against the dollar as Middle East risks persist, affecting Korea's export competitiveness despite strong product demand.
sections.AI & Economy: Korean AI company Lyuton AX announced enterprise automation infrastructure solutions, with CEO Park Min-jun identifying data preparation as the primary challenge preventing enterprises from effectively leveraging AI agents in automation. Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon maintained optimism on AI and the US economy's long-term prospects, predicting that in 10 years the US economy will have lower unemployment and higher productivity, though he cautioned that market sentiment could rapidly shift from greed to fear. Anthropic's technical and product leadership team will visit Naver headquarters on June 16th to engage with Korean developers, demonstrating the AI firm's strategic focus on Korea's advanced AI infrastructure and manufacturing capabilities ahead of its US stock listing. Focus AI completed 8 billion won in third-party capital injection to accelerate growth in AI-powered physical security and industrial safety solutions. KT Cloud launched AI servers with Rebellion's NPU technology on public cloud platforms, aligning with the government's policy to expand domestic AI semiconductor adoption.
sections.Others: Retail investors, known as 'Seohak Gaemi,' have been aggressively selling US-listed leveraged ETFs like SOXL and redirecting capital to domestic alternatives such as Samsung and Naver leveraged products, seeking tax efficiency and reduced time-zone disadvantages.
